title: Pure Runick
summary: Runick cards only, with generic hand traps and staples. Runick has no Main Deck monsters: every Runick Quick-Play Spell either disrupts the opponent and mills the top of their Deck, or Special Summons a Runick Fusion straight to the Extra Monster Zone. Using one skips your next Battle Phase. Runick Fountain lets you activate them from the hand on the opponent's turn. It also shuffles up to three used ones back into the Deck to draw that many, so the Spells loop. Hugin and Munin search the Field and Continuous Spells, Geri recovers a Spell, and Sleipnir the Runick Mane, the newest Fusion, banishes a monster until the End Phase and makes a Token when they search. Runick Fountain is Semi-Limited. Because the Quick-Plays summon the Fusions directly, the Extra Deck is all Runick.
